title: Halftone Print
description: Translate brightness into a rotated field of printed dots.

uniforms.name: intensity
uniforms.label: Intensity
uniforms.description: Blend with the original image. Zero bypasses this layer.

uniforms.name: dotSize
uniforms.label: Dot size
uniforms.description: Distance between dots in drawing-buffer pixels.

uniforms.name: angle
uniforms.label: Screen angle
uniforms.description: Rotate the dot screen in degrees.

uniforms.name: invert
uniforms.label: Invert ink
uniforms.description: Switch between dark ink on light paper and light ink on dark paper.
